hero.headline_html: Label Each Product on Every Shelf
hero.subheadline: Print accurate, clear price tags and product labels on demand. Keep your product labels accurate and your pricing consistent across the store.

about.title_html: The Right Price on Every Product
about.text_html: Print accurate product labels directly from your inventory system and place them right on the shelf. Whether it's a price update, a new arrival, or a promotion, every label is ready in seconds, no handwriting, no mismatched tags, no pricing errors. A2Z makes sure every product on your shelf is labeled correctly, every time.
